type.provenance: "No person shall dispose of any TRI-PFAS by incineration, including, but not limited to, aqueous film-forming foam that contains TRI-PFAS."

date.provenance: "Section 99. Effective date. This Act takes effect upon becoming law."

who.provenance: "No person shall dispose of any TRI-PFAS by incineration..."

action.provenance: "No person shall dispose of any TRI-PFAS by incineration..."

products.provenance: "...any TRI-PFAS by incineration, including, but not limited to, aqueous film-forming foam that contains TRI-PFAS."

value: incineration of (i) landfill gas from the decomposition of waste that may contain any perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances at a permitted sanitary landfill
incineration of (ii) landfill gas in a landfill gas recovery facility that is located at a sanitary landfill

incineration of (iii) waste at a permitted hospital, medical, and infectious waste incinerator that meets the requirements of Subpart HHH of 40 CFR Part 62, Subpart Ec of 40 CFR Part 60, or the Board-adopted State Plan requirements for hospital, medical, and infectious waste incinerators, as applicable
incineration of (iv) sludges, biosolids, or other solids or by‑products generated at or by a municipal wastewater treatment plant or facility
exceptions.provenance: "Nothing in this Section applies to the incineration of (i) landfill gas ... (ii) landfill gas in a landfill gas recovery facility ... (iii) waste at a permitted hospital, medical, and infectious waste incinerator ... (iv) sludges, biosolids, or other solids or by‑products generated at or by a municipal wastewater treatment plant or facility."
